movie.title: Simpsley
movie.overview: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she’s tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner’s clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In this animated crime comedy mashup, desperate con artist Marge Bouvier travels to Italy to bring home a wealthy heir, only to plot a takeover of his opulent lifestyle while contending with his insufferable houseguest, Homer Simpsley.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Broke and opportunistic, con-artist Marge Bouvier accepts an assignment in Italy to persuade the affluent Seymour Skinner to return to his family duties back home. Upon arrival, Marge is instantly captivated by the luxurious Mediterranean lifestyle and decides she wants a piece of the high life for herself. However, her schemes hit a major snag in the form of Homer Simpsley, Skinner's overly clingy and remarkably dim-witted parasitic housemate. To claim her fortune, Marge must navigate a chaotic web of deceit, desire, and Italian currency.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Faced with financial ruin, cunning con artist Marge Bouvier seizes what seems like a straightforward opportunity when she is paid to travel to Italy. Her mission is to track down Seymour Skinner, a gullible and wealthy heir, and convince him to give up his carefree abroad life to return home. However, once Marge experiences the dazzling luxury and effortless charm of Skinner's Italian estate, her original task takes a back seat to her own ambition. She begins orchestrating a devious scheme to insinuate herself into his inner circle and secure a lavish future for herself. Standing firmly in her way is Homer Simpsley, a profoundly dim-witted and relentless moocher who has permanently attached himself to Skinner's hospitality. Homer's unpredictable behavior and constant presence threaten to expose Marge's lies at every turn. As Marge attempts to manipulate the gullible Skinner, she finds herself tangled in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse with Homer. The tension escalates as lust, greed, and desperate cover-ups spiral out of control against the stunning backdrop of the Italian coast. Ultimately, Marge must use every trick in her arsenal to outsmart her chaotic rival before her lavish facade completely unravels.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Simpsley is a dark animated crime comedy that offers a wildly satirical, Simpsons-inspired spin on high-stakes psychological thrillers like The Talented Mr. Ripley. The story follows Marge Bouvier, a penniless hustler who gets hired to retrieve rich mama's boy Seymour Skinner from his endless Italian vacation. What starts as a simple errand quickly turns into a deceitful quest for wealth once Marge tastes the sweetness of luxury. Blending sharp comedy with tense drama, the narrative explores how far a desperate opportunist will go to steal a life that isn't hers, all while clashing with Homer Simpsley—the ultimate obnoxious houseguest whose presence makes pulling off the perfect crime hilariously complicated.

story_structure.climax: Marge's scheme reaches a boiling point when her secrets threaten to implode, forcing a confrontation where she must navigate severe jeopardy to keep her true motives from being exposed.
story_structure.conflict: Upon arrival, Marge becomes seduced by Seymour's affluent lifestyle, but her plan to cozy up to him is hindered by Homer Simpsley, Seymour's clingy, dim-witted houseguest who refuses to leave.
story_structure.resolution: The dust settles on the deception in Italy, leaving Marge to face the permanent consequences of her ambition, lies, and tangled relationships.
story_structure.introduction: Penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier travels to Italy under orders to convince Seymour Skinner, a wealthy heir living lavishly abroad, to return home to his family and responsibilities.
story_structure.risingAction: Marge weaves a web of lies to manipulate Seymour while attempting to sidestep or undermine Homer, leading to tense complications, forbidden desires, and escalating deceptions among the Italian lira.
